contact_sources.quote: Non-Executive Director Carol L’Heveder Carol is a corporate and financial services lawyer with over 30 years of international experience, notably at Linklaters, as European general counsel for Merrill Lynch private banking, head of legal EMEA for State Street and head of regulatory affairs at Invesco Asset Management. She is currently a partner at Gunner Cooke LLP, advising investment firms and entrepreneurs on FCA regulatory and conduct matters, corporate governance and senior management responsibility. She is also a non-executive director and is currently the shareholder representative on the board of Flarin Holdings Limited, which is part of Infirst Healthcare, an OTC pharmaceutical group based in the UK and the US.
